decision_question: At the same 19 percent regular detail budget, can a dense-defect singleton oracle select global-shift lifting blocks that meet the adaptive rank-16 AV capacity gate?
leakage_policy: The singleton oracle reads each same-record dense AV defect and is explicitly non-deployable.
The energy baseline reads only current K/V and remains the runtime-observable incumbent.
No reusable selector, basis, or predictor is fit from validation or test records.
This development-exposed oracle can only diagnose function-class headroom.
stop_rules: If the oracle misses either adaptive capacity gate, stop Butterfly-lifting, local cyclic, learned-flow, and detail-router work.
If the oracle passes quality but improves less than 20 percent over energy, do not train a selector.
Do not claim deployability, attention speedup, or rollout quality from oracle selection.
